products.d: Commercial and industrial air coolers for large, open or semi-open spaces.
products.i: Symphony coolers use evaporative technology and are widely used where spot or area cooling is needed without a full air-conditioning plant. The range we supply covers portable commercial units, industrial coolers and desert-type coolers.
items: Mobile commercial cooler for shops, halls and workspaces.
Larger mobile unit for wider commercial areas.
Industrial cooler for factory floors and workshops.
Desert-type cooler for dry, hot environments.

products.d: Ductable, cassette and VRV air-conditioning equipment for commercial buildings.
products.i: Commercial air conditioning ranges from ductable units serving several rooms to VRV systems for larger buildings. The right choice depends on floor area, layout, occupancy and ceiling space.
items: Ductable unit for central distribution through ducting.
1 TR ductable air conditioner for smaller zones.
Variable refrigerant flow system for multi-zone buildings.

products.d: Duct products and ducted equipment for air distribution.
products.i: This category covers three different things: ducting material (GI and pre-insulated panels), ducted air-conditioning equipment that connects to ducts, and duct installation solutions. They are listed together because they are specified together.
items: Ducted equipment (not duct material); distributes air via ducting.

products.d: Ceiling-mounted cassette units for even air distribution.
products.i: Cassette units sit flush in the ceiling and discharge air in one, two or four directions. Selection should follow room shape, ceiling void and load, so we suggest sharing your space details before choosing.
items: Cassette unit operating on a chilled-water system.
Four-direction airflow for central ceiling positions.
One-way discharge for narrow spaces or wall-side positions.

products.d: Water-based cooling for ventilated industrial and commercial areas.
products.i: Evaporative coolers cool air by passing it over wetted media. They work best in well-ventilated spaces where fresh-air supply is available. Actual results depend on local humidity and airflow, so we do not quote fixed temperature drops.
items: Industrial air cooler for large work areas.
Symphony Movicool XXL Industrial Air Cooler

products.d: Inline fans, kitchen hoods and commercial exhaust fans.
products.i: Exhaust equipment removes heat, fumes, steam and stale air. Fans, hoods and cabinet units do different jobs: hoods capture at the source, fans move the air.
items: Fan fitted within a duct run.
Hood that captures cooking fumes at the source.
Enclosed inline fan for quieter, concealed installation.

products.d: AHUs, fan coil units and fabricated duct sections.
products.i: An air handling unit conditions and circulates air through ductwork, typically with chilled water. Fan coil units serve smaller zones. Selection depends on airflow, coil capacity and available space.
items: 40LW006 4RD Single Skin Ceiling Suspended AHU Carrier
Rectangular duct fabricated for AHU connections.

products.d: Ventilation and exhaust ducting for commercial and industrial sites.
products.i: Exhaust systems combine fans, ducting and discharge points to remove contaminated or hot air. Duct sizing and routing matter as much as the fan, and we support both supply and fabrication.
items: GI duct for supply and exhaust runs.

products.d: Foil and bubble insulation for ducting and thermal control.
products.i: Insulation limits heat gain on ducts and surfaces. We supply sheet products used with HVAC ducting and similar installations. Share your application and we will confirm suitable thickness and type.

services.t: Help choosing ductable, cassette or VRV systems for your space.
GI and pre-insulated duct supply and fabrication.
Foil and bubble insulation for ducts and surfaces.
